expectations.interiority_vs_matched: below 0.5 — the panel prefers the text that kept its interiority. PRIMARY: word-matched and formatting-matched, so only the choice of deleted sentences differs
expectations.interiority_vs_original: below 0.5 — but confounded by the §78.1 separator downgrade; read only beside the primary
expectations.stat_flatten_vs_original: below 0.5 — the panel prefers live stat values. Layout-preserving, so this one is clean

interiority_vs_matched.reading: resamples passages and personas both; `gate1.paired_ci` resamples passages only and over-rejects at 3.8-23.9% against a nominal 2.5% at this n. Read the fourth rung of `evaluate.verdict()` against this interval, not that one

interiority_vs_original.reading: resamples passages and personas both; `gate1.paired_ci` resamples passages only and over-rejects at 3.8-23.9% against a nominal 2.5% at this n. Read the fourth rung of `evaluate.verdict()` against this interval, not that one

stat_flatten_vs_original.reading: resamples passages and personas both; `gate1.paired_ci` resamples passages only and over-rejects at 3.8-23.9% against a nominal 2.5% at this n. Read the fourth rung of `evaluate.verdict()` against this interval, not that one

conditions.blind: 0.40 < win rate < 0.60: the panel cannot see the defect. A mapped hole — a human found it in one read and no instrument here detects it, so nothing may be selected on this axis
conditions.detects: win rate <= 0.40: the panel prefers the text retaining the feature, so it detects the defect. This is an axis a reader model could be optimised on in the human's direction
conditions.no_sham_floor: no layout sham is run. §78 measured why rewhitespace cannot be this design's floor, and the primary arm needs none: its two sides carry identical formatting by construction, so there is no layout difference for a floor to bound. See SHAM_NOT_RUN
conditions.precondition: per-arm positional bias within 0.40-0.60. Pooling was wrong in §74 and the per-arm rule is pre-registered here rather than adopted mid-run
conditions.prefers: win rate >= 0.60: the panel prefers the defect. A mapped hole of the worse kind and a hard prohibition: a reader model in the loop would select FOR it, which is what §74 believed it had shown about the em dash before §78 withdrew the number
conditions.primary: interiority_vs_matched is the arm that decides the interiority question. interiority_vs_original is confounded by formatting and cannot license a reading on its own; if the two disagree, the difference between them is the size of the §78.1 confound and is itself the finding
conditions.strict_from_next_run: DECLARED 2026-08-18, AFTER §81's run and governing from the NEXT one, never applied backwards: DETECTS and PREFERS additionally require the two-way interval to exclude 0.50 in the claimed direction. §81's interiority arm cleared the registered 0.40 threshold by 0.011 with an interval of [0.1667, 0.6667], which is not evidence. `per_arm_strict` reports it now so the two readings are visible side by side rather than swapped

ladder.confound_note: formatting-matched arm 0.3889 against formatting-confounded 0.1111: a gap of 0.2778. §78.1's separator downgrade is the only difference between the two comparisons, so the gap is its contribution — read as a direction, not an estimate, and only when both arms clear their preconditions

interiority_vs_matched.note: 0.5 is unbiased; distance from it is the share of the answer that is layout
